incidents.name: Issues creating projects from workspace chats

incident_updates.body: Creating new projects from workspace chats is working normally again following a fix. Building and editing existing projects was not affected. This issue is now resolved.
Creating new projects from workspace chats is currently not working for some users. Building and editing existing projects is not affected. Our team has identified the cause and is rolling out a fix.

incidents.name: Projects stuck in Recovering acceptance after a draft merge

incident_updates.body: We have deployed the fix and resolved the issue that caused projects to get stuck on "Recovering acceptance" after merging a draft. If your project is still stuck, please retry to allow it to recover and resume editing and building.

Affected projects remain stuck on "Recovering acceptance" after merging a draft, preventing editing and building. We have identified the issue and prepared a fix. We expect deployment to complete in approximately 35 minutes. Once the fix is fully deployed, retrying should allow affected projects to recover. Projects not using drafts remain unaffected.

Projects affected by the draft merge issue are unable to edit, in addition to being stuck on "Recovering acceptance". We are investigating the issue and working to restore editing and building for affected projects. Projects not using drafts are unaffected.
Some projects are getting stuck on "Recovering acceptance" after merging a draft, preventing the merge from completing. We are investigating the issue.

incidents.name: Some users may see errors sending messages

incident_updates.body: Some new projects failed to start because one of our providers had a capacity problem. This is now fixed. If your project did not start, please try again.
The problem is resolved, we are monitoring the situation
> Some users are seeing errors when sending messages in the editor or creating new projects. Our team is investigating and working on a fix.

incidents.name: Issues with previews, remix, and static asset serving

incident_updates.body: The issues affecting previews, remix, and static asset serving have been resolved.
We are experiencing issues with previews, remix, and static asset serving.

incidents.name: Issues with image generation and editing

incident_updates.body: This incident has been resolved. Image generation and editing works as normal again.
Image generation and image editing in the Lovable chat are failing for some users. Image features in apps built with Lovable are not affected. We're working on a fix.

incidents.name: Some .shop domains purchased through Lovable are unavailable

incident_updates.body: This incident has been resolved, and .shop domains should function as normal again.

This issue is related to an outage at the .shop domain registry, affecting .shop domains across all providers. Affected domains are starting to load again, and we're monitoring as service is fully restored.
Some custom domains ending in .shop that were purchased through Lovable are intermittently not loading. We're investigating the cause of this issue.

incidents.name: Elevated errors when Enabling Lovable Cloud

incident_updates.body: Enabling Lovable Cloud is back to normal operational levels.
We're seeing full recovery of ability to enable Lovable Cloud and will monitor to ensure it's stable
We're experiencing problems enabling Lovable Cloud in all regions for Lovable projects. Existing Lovable Cloud projects are not impacted

Some users in the Asia-Pacific region are experiencing errors or delays when creating a new backend for their project. Other regions are not affected. Our team is investigating with one of our providers.

incidents.name: Some users are seeing web search fail when the agent uses it

incident_updates.body: This issue has been resolved.
Some users are seeing web search fail when the agent uses it. We are investigating with one of our providers.

incidents.name: Degraded performance enabling Lovable Cloud

incident_updates.body: Enabling Lovable Cloud for projects has returned to normal success rates.
We're seeing signs of recovery and will continue to monitor. Success rates for enabling Lovable Cloud are returning to normal levels.
We're experiencing problems when enabling Lovable Cloud and will provide updates as we have them.

incidents.name: Builds failing for some users

incident_updates.body: This issue has been resolved. Builds and edits are working normally again. If you are still seeing errors, please try reloading the page.

> Some users are currently seeing errors when building or editing their projects. We have identified the issue and our team is actively working on a fix. We will post an update as soon as more information is available.

incidents.name: Previews and builds failing to start

incident_updates.body: The issue has been resolved and Lovable is fully functional again.
Some users are seeing previews and builds fail to start. Retrying usually works, but it may take longer than normal. Our team is working on restoring full capacity.

incidents.name: Errors signing in and performing account actions

incident_updates.body: This issue has been resolved and sign-in, publishing, and other account actions are working normally again. If you were affected, reload the page to pick up the fix.

Some users are currently experiencing errors when signing in or signing up, and when performing account actions such as creating or sharing a project, creating API keys, changing workspace members, and setting up SMS two-factor authentication. Existing sessions and published projects are not affected. Our team is investigating.

incidents.name: Lovable Desktop App for Windows Crashing

incident_updates.body: The issue causing the Windows Desktop App to crash has now been resolved and the app is working as normal.
The Lovable desktop app for Windows installed from the Microsoft Store is currently crashing on launch. We have identified the cause and are working on releasing an updated version.

incidents.name: Map and location search issues in some published projects

incident_updates.body: Map and location search issues in some published projects have been resolved. We have pushed a fix so that projects using location search are guided to the working setup, and if your project is still affected you can ask the Lovable agent to fix it and it will apply the update for you. All systems are operating normally.

Some published projects that use our maps connector for map and location search features may temporarily not load results correctly, for example place lookups or location images. Only projects using the maps connector are affected. This is a temporary measure while we investigate, and we will share an update as soon as we have more.

Some published projects that use map and location search features may temporarily not load results correctly, for example place lookups or location images. Projects that use our built-in maps connector are not affected. We will share an update as soon as we have more information.

incidents.name: Partial outage affecting the editor

incident_updates.body: Upstream issue resolved
Some users are experiencing issues with the Editor. We are investigating and working to restore normal service.

incidents.name: Lovable Cloud project creation and remix failures

incident_updates.body: The issue affecting Lovable Cloud project creation, remixing, and management operations has been resolved.
Lovable Cloud project creation and remix are currently failing. Existing projects are unaffected. We are investigating an upstream service issue.

incidents.name: Degraded performance when enabling Lovable Cloud

incident_updates.body: Enabling Lovable Cloud has resumed to normal success rates.
We're seeing Lovable Cloud enablement back to full success rates and will monitor to confirm that it remains stable.
We're seeing elevated error rates for projects enabling Lovable Cloud and are actively investigating.

incidents.name: Degraded performance for app email delivery

incident_updates.body: Email sending on behalf of Lovable apps has returned to normal operation.
We're seeing signs of full recovery and will monitor to ensure it's stable. Any emails attempted to be sent during this period of degraded performance will still be processed and sent out to users.

We're currently experiencing degraded performance in one of our systems responsible for sending emails on behalf of Lovable apps. This means emails for email verification are delayed. We are working with our email provider to restore functionality as soon as we can.

incidents.name: Elevated errors in Central Europe

incident_updates.body: This incident has now been resolved.

Error rates in Central Europe have returned to normal and the service is operating as expected. We are continuing to monitor closely while we work on a permanent fix, and there may be brief disruptions again before that fix is in place.

Some users in Central Europe are seeing errors loading Lovable and apps built with Lovable. This is a recurrence of the issue we reported yesterday. Our team is actively investigating and we will share an update as soon as we know more.
This incident has been resolved.

Some users in Central Europe are currently seeing errors when loading Lovable. Apps built on Lovable may also be affected for users in that region. We are working with one of our providers to resolve this and will post an update as soon as we know more.

incidents.name: Issues creating Shopify stores

incident_updates.body: The issue has been resolved and Shopify store creation is working again.
Some customers may be unable to create Shopify stores. We are investigating the issue and will provide an update as soon as we have more information.

incidents.name: Delayed chat responses and real-time updates

incident_updates.body: Real-time updates and chat responses in the editor are working normally again. Thank you for your patience.

We have deployed a fix and are seeing signs of recovery. Real-time updates and chat responses in the editor should now be working better for most users. Our team is continuing to monitor until the issue is fully resolved.

Some customers may see delayed or missing real-time updates in the editor, including chat responses that do not appear as they are generated. The editor may also fail to load for some users. Our team is actively working on a fix.

incidents.name: Remixing and enabling Lovable Cloud are failing for some projects

incident_updates.body: This incident has been resolved. Remixing and creating projects with Lovable Cloud should be working normally again.

Remixing is still failing for most projects that use Lovable Cloud. Enabling Lovable Cloud on a project may also fail for some users. This is due to an issue with one of our providers. Our team is investigating and we will share an update as soon as we know more.
Remixing is currently failing for most projects that use Lovable Cloud, due to an issue with one of our providers. Our team is investigating and we will share an update as soon as we know more.

incidents.name: We are currently experiencing issues with our Shopify integration.

incident_updates.body: Shopify integration has been restored.

> We are currently experiencing issues with our Shopify integration. Creating new Lovable apps with Shopify is not working right now, and our team is actively investigating. We will share an update as soon as we know more.

incidents.name: Degraded Lovable Cloud project creation

incident_updates.body: A fix has been rolled out by our vendor, and we’re seeing improved performance for Lovable Cloud creation. The incident is now considered resolved, and we’ll continue to monitor performance.
We’re seeing degraded Lovable Cloud project creation in the America region due to an issue with our vendor. Project creation in other regions is not currently affected.

incidents.name: Project previews and publishing not working.

incident_updates.body: The issue has been resolved and both previews and publishing is now working as expected.
Some users are currently unable to publish their projects or see project previews update. Our team is actively investigating and we will share an update as soon as we know more.
Some users are currently unable to see updated previews of their projects. Our team is investigating and working on a fix.
